findings.note: Capitol Beat reports he sponsored SB 67, which would require absentee voters to give the number of their driver's license or official state ID card, or photocopies of a passport, employee ID card, utility bill or bank statement. The Senate passed it on 2021-02-23 (35-18 per Fox 5 Atlanta and the Georgia Recorder). Official legislature page could not be read.
